description: A variable is used before it has been defined or declared.
explanation: The program is trying to use a variable that does not currently exist in the current scope.
fix: Define the variable before using it or check the variable name for spelling mistakes.

description: A variable name is referenced but was never created.
explanation: The variable being referenced has not been defined before this line.
fix: Create the variable before using it or use the correct variable name.

description: The code contains invalid Python syntax.
explanation: Python cannot understand the structure of the code.
fix: Check the syntax around the reported line.
